about_the_game:
Game Features

This game simulates some everyday parking situations as well as some surreal ones. If you're confident in your driving skills, give it a try!

Game Content

Players can unlock and control six different land vehicles, each with unique appearances and performance, to complete the game. The game is level-based— in each standalone level, you control the vehicle of your choice through various roads or obstacles and park it in the designated area to pass.

Game Controls Guide

The controls are simple. All you need are four directional buttons (for forward, backward, left, and right) and one button to confirm parking. That’s it.

Hidden Elements

It's worth mentioning that the developer has included some fun hidden elements in the game for you to discover.

Game Background

This game was born from something I face every single day: parking. I live in an old neighborhood where each building only has a tiny patch of land for parking. If you go out for just a while, chances are your spot is gone when you're back. Many neighbors have given up driving entirely. That means the few mobile spots left become a daily battlefield. Scratches on your car? Bent license plates? Sometimes even smashed windows… I started thinking, what if I drove an armored vehicle? Let’s see who dares mess with it then! And that’s how I Park on Earth was born. Why this name? Because I hope one day my neighbors realize: we are all just passing through on this planet—no one gets to park forever. A little more understanding and tolerance, and we’d all be happier.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti or AMD RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Choose a suitable vehicle, use the four directional keys, and drive it into the designated parking area. That's it.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil
